metadata.title: Cinematic Shadow Portrait with Vertical Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up studio portrait of a man with feathered hair, using his hands to frame his face. A distinct, sharp shadow of a hand is projected across his eyes and nose. The composition features a neutral, textured grey background with a strong vertical typographic stack on the right side, accented by a large, gestural red brushstroke.
coreVisualRelationships: The projected shadow interacts directly with the subject's facial features.
The vertical text column balances the horizontal gesture of the top hand.
The vibrant red brushstroke provides a high-contrast focal point against the muted palette.
The grainy film texture unifies the photographic and graphic elements.
coreInvariants: Sharp, high-contrast shadow projection across the face
Vertical orientation of all text elements
Neutral grey background with visible film grain
Subject's hands framing the face in a 'mask' gesture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying the majority of the frame from the chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's visible eye peering through the fingers and the red brushstroke on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the hands framing the face, follows the shadow across the eyes, then moves vertically down the text column on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper left and right corners to allow for typographic breathing room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted grey and warm skin tones (neutral base).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black shadows and dark clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant primary red for the gestural graphic element.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a single high-saturation red pop; high value contrast in the facial shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Strict vertical stacking of individual characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; standard glyphs used in a non-standard vertical orientation

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the background, adjacent to the subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in two different scales for primary and secondary information.
graphicDevices: Large, expressive red brushstroke or 'kanji-style' mark
Thin vertical rule lines separating text columns

avoid: Script fonts for the main text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, 80s-era geometric feel and vertical legibility.
Provides the necessary monolinear weight and clarity for vertical stacking.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a man with 80s feathered hair, hands framing his face, with a sharp hand-shaped shadow projected across his eyes. Background is a textured, grainy grey. Include a large, thick, expressive red brushstroke on the right side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white, uppercase, geometric sans-serif text in a vertical stack on the right side. Ensure characters are spaced widely apart vertically. Add a thin white vertical line to the left of the main text column.

verificationChecks: Is the text stacked vertically one character at a time?
Is there a sharp shadow projected across the subject's face?
Is the red brushstroke vibrant and gestural?
Is the overall image texture grainy like film?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Specific catalog numbers in the corner
postGenerationChecks: Check that the shadow does not obscure the eyes completely.
Ensure the red mark looks hand-painted, not digitally generated.
Verify the vertical text is perfectly aligned and legible.
Confirm the film grain is consistent across the entire image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast shadow-play portrait with a minimalist vertical typographic column and a single, bold gestural color accent.
